annotations.title: Republish a blog post on Hashnode

description: Republish a blog post on the brand's Hashnode blog with its CANONICAL URL (Hashnode's original article URL) pointing at the original, so search engines credit the brand's own page. Free, no credits. Give EITHER sourceUrl (Hermoso reads the page, turns the article into Markdown with its images, and uses the page's own canonical URL) OR title + text in Markdown. A line linking back to the original is added unless footer:false. A post whose canonical URL is already on the publication is refused, never posted twice (allowDuplicate:true overrides). Hashnode's API works only for a publication on Hashnode's Pro plan; a free publication is refused with that reason. Not connected: Connectors > Hashnode, or connect_connector with provider hashnode (token).

allowDuplicate.description: post it even though an identical post was just made

brand.description: WHICH PROFILE this post belongs to, for THIS CALL ONLY (beats the connection’s pin): an id or exact name from list_brands. A name that matches no profile, or two, is REFUSED and nothing is posted.

canonicalUrl.description: the original post’s address; defaults to the page’s own canonical URL

coverImageUrl.description: the cover image; defaults to the page’s share image

footer.description: false leaves out the “Originally published at …” line

hook.description: the post's angle — a list_hooks id or your own wording, reused exactly

ideaId.description: short id of the content-plan idea this post came from

idempotencyKey.description: any stable string: a repeat within 24h returns the original post instead of posting again

recipe.description: the post's FORMAT id, e.g. "slideshow" or "imessage_chat" — post_performance groups by it, so reuse one id per format

sourceUrl.description: the original post to republish: its article, images and canonical URL are read from the page

tags.description: tags; read off the title when omitted

text.description: the body in Markdown (taken from the page when sourceUrl is given)

title.description: the title (taken from the page when sourceUrl is given)
